en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Ismail Bin Baie, from his uncle Hamza Bin Bazie, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ibrahim<sup>as</sup> (7th Imam<sup>asws</sup>) having said:
‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said to Ja’far<sup>as</sup>: ‘Eat the Quince, for it strengthens the heart and emboldens the timid’.
en.sarwar: 4. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn ’Isma‘il ibn Bazi‘ from his uncle Hamzah ibn Bazi‘ who has said the following: “Abu Ibrahim, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause,
said to Ja‘far, ‘O Ja‘far, eat quince; it strengthens the heart and emboldens the coward heart.’”
